Is it really free?
Yes. Playing is free and there is nothing to buy on the site. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account and no newsletter, you just pick a game and play.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. The games run instantly in your browser, with no download and no installs.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, many games are made for touch and are collected in the Mobile category. Games built for a wide screen ask you to turn the phone sideways, and a few older games need a keyboard and mouse and say so on their page.
Is it safe for my children?
We only allow family-friendly games, with no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are collected in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Recently played games, favourites and your light or dark choice are kept in your own browser and never leave your device. Most games save their own progress the same way, but clearing your browser data or using private mode will lose it.
What do the cookie settings do?
Visitors in Europe are asked before non-essential cookies are used. You can change your choice at any time with Cookie settings in the footer.
Where do the games come from?

Six games are made by Door 404, the studio behind the site, and 23 were sent in directly by independent developers. The rest are licensed from the distribution networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, and we never copy games from other portals.
I made a game. Can I submit it?
Yes, it is free and non-exclusive at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. A real person plays every submission, and an accepted game gets its own page that credits you and links back to you.
How do I get my game removed?
Your game stays hosted on your own server, and you can have it removed at any time by emailing contact@ilovewebgames.com.
Can I put a game on my own website?
If the game is one of ours, its page has an "Embed this game" box with ready-made code. Games from other developers are not ours to licence, so we cannot offer them for embedding.
How can I reach a real person?
Email contact@ilovewebgames.com. The site is run by Door 404, an escape room and game studio from Novi Sad, Serbia.
